title: Signed-out visitors who open a Journey link or press Create a free account land back on that Journey

source.ref: Journey audit 2026-11-17 (project thread: Dial in the Journey Wizard and Journeys)

detail: Three leaks on the signed-out path into a Journey. (1) TWIN_RULES rewrote /journeys/<slug> straight to /discover/journeys/<slug>, but getPublicJourney 404s an unlisted Journey, and unlisted is the share-by-link setting the launch surface hands an author, so every signed-out recipient of an unlisted link (buyers of an unlisted paid Journey included) hit a 404. (2) The free Journey's public page sent both "Create a free account" buttons to a bare /sign-in, so a visitor from search or a share link signed up and landed on the default home instead of the Journey (the paid button already carried next). (3) /journeys/new sent a signed-out visitor to / ahead of its own sign-in branch. Fixed 2026-11-17: Journeys are a lookup rule; the (main) layout resolves it through getPublicJourney (dynamic import, kept off the shell's static graph) and sends anything without a public twin to /sign-in?next=/journeys/<slug>. Both free buttons use journeyBuySignInPath(slug). /journeys/new redirects to sign-in with next, query kept. public-twin.test.ts and program-catalog.test.ts updated to the lookup shape.

verify.note: Fails if /journeys/<slug> is a direct rewrite again, the layout has no journey lookup with a sign-in fallback, the free Journey page links a bare /sign-in, or /journeys/new sends a signed-out visitor to /.
